name: Rubescent-Doxology
description: Cloud-architecture stacks to the horizon in every direction, ammonia cirrus above, sulfurous murk below. Great storm eyes stare up out of the depths, unhurried and permanent.
The deck plates hum with distant thunder that never resolves into an actual front. Sleep comes hard at first; later, it comes too easily.
Trade at the smuggler cache changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants deal fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
For traders, antimatter traces and helium-3 alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
